Alert / other · Lithuania

Suspected drone alert disrupts Vilnius airport and rail in Lithuania

20 May 2026 · Vilnius

Unresolved-origin alert

On 20 May 2026 an air-danger warning linked to a suspected drone (UAV) was issued for Vilnius, Lithuania, and its surrounding airspace. The warning, which included a call to shelter, triggered protective closures in the capital. The airport, rail services, the parliament and schools were reportedly disrupted, and authorities imposed temporary traffic restrictions.

How many suspected drones were involved, and of what model, was not specified, and the route is unknown. Who operated the drone, and from which country it came, has not been established; no final attribution has been made.

No confirmed impact was reported.
